PSCD_CUTOFF_RULE: No evidence with publication_date after PSCD_CUTOFF_DATE may enter any arm's retrieval payload. This rule is frozen BEFORE any PSCD generation. Violation = experiment invalidated.
enforcement: The retrieval snapshot is built ONLY from sources with publication_date <= PSCD_CUTOFF_DATE. The snapshot hash includes this cutoff, so any post-cutoff evidence would change the hash and be detected.
